title: Law to inform accused youth about the legal process
summary: This bill would require the Department of Probation to give young people accused of crimes clear notices about how their case could proceed, including options to adjust the case, referrals for prosecution, presentencing reports and possible outcomes. It would also require youth to be told their rights before any intake interview with a probation officer and to receive information about legal aid organizations they can contact. The law would take effect 90 days after passage.
